summary: Verified the Sep 12 2026 duplicate-Store-Request fix (blocks a retry from creating a second SAP Proposal + second Store Request while an earlier open request for the same material/site/quantity/requester still exists). Wrote 12 pytest cases in /app/backend/tests/test_duplicate_store_request_iter163.py, ALL 12 PASSED. (a) Unit tests on store_approval_service.find_open_request: exact match returns the doc; different requester/quantity/site/material each return None; resolved/cancelled status returns None; pending/issuing/partial_pending_planner all count as OPEN. (b) Integration tests on server._run_create_and_release_job with check_component_availability + _create_proposal_for_payload monkey-patched: a duplicate open request causes the new job to fail fast with result.reason='duplicate_store_request', result.production_proposal_id=None, error string embeds the existing store-request ID, AND _create_proposal_for_payload was NEVER called - proving no second SAP Proposal is created. A DIFFERENT requester was NOT blocked and reached _create_proposal_for_payload once, ending in waiting_store_approval. The no-shortage regression path still calls _create_proposal_for_payload exactly once and completes normally. Cross-checked via a direct localhost:8001 call on a seeded failed job: /api/production-confirmation/create-and-release-order/status/{job_id} returns the exact contract the frontend expects (result.reason='duplicate_store_request', production_proposal_id=null, error mentions request ID). Frontend JSX (ProductionConfirmationPage.js lines 1976-2000) code-reviewed: j.failure.reason==='duplicate_store_request' branch fires FIRST (before the production_proposal_id-based branch), rendering the exact required copy 'Nothing new was created in SAP - an identical open Store Request already covers this need. Check the Store Approval screen instead of creating another order for the same shortage.' Frontend maps job.result -> j.failure at lines 1325 and 1335, so the backend->UI contract lines up. Live UI screenshot verification through the preview host was NOT possible this iteration - the public ingress (sap-data-sync.preview.emergentagent.com) intermittently returned Cloudflare 502 Bad Gateway during the test window (backend itself served the same request at 200 on localhost:8001 - transient ingress issue, unrelated to this fix). The API+code+contract level verification is complete and sufficient to confirm the fix.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py _run_create_and_release_job's exception handler (lines 3716-3726) sets result.reason='pipeline_error' with production_proposal_id=proposal_id (may still be None if the failure happened before Proposal creation). Note that if find_open_request itself raised (Mongo timeout etc.), the outer handler would report reason='pipeline_error' rather than 'duplicate_store_request', but production_proposal_id would still be None - user-visible copy would show the generic 'Nothing was created in SAP yet...' message. Acceptable given find_open_request is a single well-indexed find_one, but worth being aware of.

The dedup key is (site_id, material_id, quantity, requester). A retry with the exact same shortage but a subtly different quantity (e.g. user typed 5 vs 5.0) would NOT be treated as a duplicate. Both routes normalize via Pydantic's float coercion so 5 and 5.0 collide correctly in Mongo, verified by the exact-match unit test. Genuine different quantities (5 vs 6) correctly bypass the block per test_different_quantity_returns_none.
ProductionConfirmationPage.js is now 2655 lines (up from 2650 last iteration) - still well past the 700-line guideline, called out in iters 160/161/162 too, no action taken yet.

success_rate.backend: 100% (12/12 tests, both unit find_open_request paths and integration _run_create_and_release_job paths)
success_rate.frontend: code-review + backend API contract verified. Live preview-URL screenshot blocked by transient ingress 502 - not a code issue.

seed_data_creation: Only ephemeral: pytest fixtures insert TEST_ITER163_* store_requests + background_jobs docs and delete them at teardown. One ad-hoc background_jobs doc (TEST_ITER163_UI_bef8217a) was created for the failed API status check and manually deleted before finishing.
context_for_next_testing_agent: The duplicate-Store-Request fix is fully unit + integration tested. If a future iteration ever manages a real end-to-end reproduction (short material available in this dev tenant), positively assert on the LIVE POST /api/production-confirmation/create-and-release-order path that no proposal-create SOAP call goes out and no second store_requests doc gets inserted on the duplicate retry. Preview URL served 502 during Iter 163's UI verification window - likely a transient Cloudflare ingress hiccup, worth a quick retry before assuming any real regression.
rca of the issue: Original bug: a SAP timeout (or any other pipeline error) during Create Production Order left the first job in 'failed' state, but the user's natural retry (same material/site/quantity/requester) went straight through the whole pipeline again - Proposal #2 was really written to SAP (undeletable) and Store Request #2 was inserted, so the store team saw two open asks for what was really one need. Fix: store_approval_service.find_open_request(site_id, material_id, quantity, requester) filters store_requests by {status: {pending|issuing|partial_pending_planner}, site, material, quantity, requester}; server._run_create_and_release_job now calls it right after computing short_rm and BEFORE _create_proposal_for_payload - on a hit, the job is failed with result.reason='duplicate_store_request', production_proposal_id=None, and an error message pointing the user to the existing store-request ID. No SAP write occurs on the duplicate path. The frontend Active Orders row detects j.failure.reason==='duplicate_store_request' and shows a distinct 'identical open Store Request' message pointing to the Store Approval screen instead of the generic 'nothing was created in SAP yet' copy.
